primary.author: Ulrich Habock
primary.revision: Author upload June 13 2026; full web-extracted text, not byte-pinned PDF
primary.summary: The nonlinear theorem requires finite-field RS codes, degree-two constraints, rational subprobability weights with denominator B, and theta=1-sqrt(rho)*(1+1/(2m)), m>=3. Sufficiently many successful challenges imply jointly agreeing polynomial components satisfying a formal constraint identity. The folding proof uses projected consistency weights, then gates them by fold equality. It preserves the agreement threshold; denominators grow as 2^i. The general inner-product case invokes this nonlinear theorem.
primary.version_warning: Search-indexed eprint PDF has older numbering: its Theorem4 is linear weighted subcode agreement. Do not conflate that version with the author revision nonlinear Theorem4. Extracted nonlinear error formula and cross-references still require PDF typography audit before numerical certification.

new_checked_core.representation: Integer numerator a(x) in [0,B]. Measure of event A equals sum_x a(x)*1_A(x)/(B*N).
lemmas: consistency_gated_agreement: candidate agreement with adaptive next oracle under gated weights is bounded by agreement with actual fold under fixed projected weights.
consistency_projected_mass: inverse-image measure numerator equals projected pair-sum numerator exactly.
consistency_pair_pullback: joint agreement recovering both source locations transfers its entire projected mass to parent candidate agreement.
new_checked_core.normalization: Parent denominator B*2N equals child denominator (2B)*N; threshold mass does not degrade geometrically. Projection geometry and polynomial candidate reconstruction still need to instantiate the generic transfer.

fixed_before_challenge: Finite field K; distinct nonzero projected RS domain Y with N elements; strict candidate degree d, 1<=d<N.
Natural consistency numerators a:Y->Nat with 0<=a(y)<=B. These are projected from the PRIOR transcript, before current challenge.
Two coefficient-linear functionals L0,L1, and sent polynomial q of degree<=2. Define Gamma(p,r)=(1-r)*L0(p)+r*L1(p)-q(r).
Agreement threshold T and complete uniform challenge set K.
needed_theorem_interface.success: For r, there EXISTS p_r of degree<d, with sum_y a(y)*1[(1-r)e(y)+r o(y)=p_r(y)]>=T and Gamma(p_r,r)=0. The existential is INSIDE the challenge event.
needed_theorem_interface.conclusion: If success_count>E then there EXIST Epoly,Opoly of degree<d with sum_y a(y)*1[e(y)=Epoly(y) AND o(y)=Opoly(y)]>=T and Gamma((1-Z)Epoly+Z Opoly,Z)=0 as a formal polynomial.
needed_theorem_interface.counterpositive: Absence of such parent-compatible Epoly,Opoly bounds success_count by E. This is the actual unproved extraction step; it is not introduced as an axiom.
needed_theorem_interface.quantifier_note: The weight a and sent q must not be selected after r. New oracle and candidate may depend on r. Gating belongs AFTER this fixed-measure contract, via the checked transfer.

actual_mapping.joint_opening_equality_weight: After joint sumcheck point u is fixed, L0(p)=acc*(1-u_i)*scalarRSResidual(tailEqWeights,p); L1(p)=acc*u_i*scalarRSResidual(tailEqWeights,p). No inversion, including zero accumulator or factors.
actual_mapping.geometry: Child y=x^2; e,o obtained by rsPairDecode of arbitrary committed values at x,-x. Reconstructed parent values E(y)+x O(y) are both-source compatible on joint agreement set.
actual_mapping.degree: Child d=parent_degree/2 and child N=parent_domain/2 preserve rate1/4. Polynomial interleaving must prove parent degree<2d.
actual_mapping.measure: Virtual initial source can start with numerator1 if it is defined exactly by authenticated wide oracle. Each committed child multiplies projected numerator by its fold-check indicator. After i folds the denominator is 2^i.
actual_mapping.joint_initial_obligation: Adaptive beta(u) combination following joint sumcheck is a separate source-candidate reduction. The later fixed-u weighted folding theorem does not establish that earlier reduction.

field_domain_requirements: Certified finite extension field and base-field embedding; characteristic not2.
Exact multiplicative domain order4D, duplicate-free representatives and squared projection exactly two-to-one.
Independent uniform full-field challenges; rejection-sampling implementation refinement.
Numerical correlated-agreement error audited for all N_i,d_i,B_i and then QROM loss; no extension degree selected here.
next_formal_steps: Instantiate pair pullback with rsPairEncode/Decode and a concrete interleaved parent polynomial.
Build the transcript-indexed natural consistency numerators and prove denominator/mass bounds by induction, with global-chain sampling equivalence.
Formalize the finite bivariate concentration theorem underlying constrained correlated agreement; ordinary three-candidate interpolation is insufficient without concentration.

A smaller independent algebra step is: three distinct specializations of ONE fixed bivariate candidate curve satisfying Gamma force its quadratic identity. This does not manufacture the concentrated curve.
